solves: Shows a short explanation for the information trigger of an nph-label without moving focus to the bubble.
use_when: The info trigger of an nph-label needs to reveal a short explanation.
do_not_use_when: The information is helper text or a field error message — that is the responsibility of nph-field.
The content needs an action, focus or persistent context — use nph-popover.

text.constraint: Carries the bubble text, already localized by the consuming application. Empty or whitespace-only does not show the bubble.

open.constraint: Shows or hides the bubble. Opening, closing and positioning are the responsibility of the consumer.

closed.changes_for_user: The bubble and its text are not shown.

open.changes_for_user: The explanation is shown by the bubble.

business_rules: The bubble opens only on trigger activation; it does not open on hover.
The text fits entirely in up to two lines, without ellipsis, automatic hyphenation or broken words.
ai_hints: Use nph-tooltip only for the short explanation opened by the info trigger of nph-label.
Do not add a title, icon, action, arrow or border.
Do not create a positioning property: the consumer opens and positions it.
For content that asks for focus or action, choose nph-popover.

accessibility.semantics: The host is a `role=status` live region from mount, open or closed.
accessibility.accessible_name: The text received in text is the content announced by the live region.
accessibility.focus: The bubble does not receive focus; focus stays on the trigger.
accessibility.contrast: The text uses color/tooltip-foreground on color/tooltip in both schemes.
accessibility.color_alternative: The explanation is conveyed by the text; color is not the only signal.

invalid_combinations: Opening on hover — the bubble opens only on trigger activation.
Adding a title, icon, action, arrow or border — the scope is text only.
Moving focus to the bubble — focus stays on the trigger.
Using nph-tooltip for content with action or focus — use nph-popover.
anti_patterns: Using the bubble as helper text or a field error message.
Cutting, truncating or breaking a word to fit in the bubble.
Applying elevation/dropdown in a subtree with a data-nph-color-scheme different from the root: the shadow may use the color of the root scheme.
